items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: he worked with me for years and years. Every job I had he worked.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Well speaking of bass players again, is there anything you can tell us about old man Glennie? How was he to work with? I knew him.
Oh yeah, that's how I worked with that old man Glennie. I mean, he worked with me for years and years. He worked with me for years and years old man Glennie. Every job I had he worked.
You started out with him and he had a three string bass. I heard he used to just have three strings on it.
